recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It applies the published Pharmacy decision to current build inputs, avoids changing unrelated NutritionOrder comments that are not Dosage.text guidance, and preserves the later R6 renderedInstruction redesign.
issue_request: FHIR-39319 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Pharmacy. It asked whether Dosage.text is merely additional free text or a text representation of the entire dosage; the accepted resolution says Dosage.text is intended as a complete representation of the dosage, commonly called the SIG, and SHOULD represent structured SIG data when structured data exists.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-39319 was found. The current Dosage spreadsheet and checked-in R5 generated history still retained the older wording that framed Dosage.text as free text for instructions too complex to code and did not say it is a complete dosage representation.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread and Pharmacy meeting records show the UK complete-string use case and Pharmacy's agreement to clarify the definition. FHIR-13222 is earlier supporting context for including administration/preparation details in Dosage.text. Later R6 work in FHIR-54014 introduced DosageDetails.renderedInstruction as the required full human-readable representation for MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction, so the MedicationRequest note needed to stop repeating the obsolete Dosage.text paragraph.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/dosage.xml so Dosage.text short, definition, and requirements state that it is a complete free-text dosage/SIG representation and should reflect current structured Dosage fields when those fields exist. Changed source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-notes.xml to align MedicationRequest dosage guidance with DosageDetails.renderedInstruction while noting that individual Dosage entries can carry complete Dosage.text SIG text.
source_changes: source/datatypes/dosage.xml: updated Dosage.text short, definition, and requirements.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-notes.xml: replaced stale Dosage.text paragraph with R6 DosageDetails.renderedInstruction guidance.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published Pharmacy clarification that administration/preparation examples belong in Dosage.text and Dosage.additionalInstruction is primarily coded.
Applied R6 decision requiring DosageDetails.renderedInstruction to communicate full dosage intent; it informed the MedicationRequest narrative update.
R6 example consistency issue found during the search path; it is Resolved - change required and not part of this applied/published seed decision.
